﻿# Fix Maven Compilation Failure: spring-boot-starter 2.7.5 -> 3.0.2

## Context

Project `IDS-Messaging-Services` (by International-Data-Spaces-Association) has a **COMPILATION_FAILURE** after a dependency upgrade bot bumped
`org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter` from `2.7.5` to `3.0.2` (major update).

Reference PR: https://github.com/International-Data-Spaces-Association/IDS-Messaging-Services/pull/694

## Your Task

The source code is in `/IDS-Messaging-Services`. Fix all compilation errors so that `mvn compile` succeeds.
I'll analyze the compilation failure and fix the issues caused by the Spring Boot 3.0.2 upgrade. Let me start by understanding the project structure and identifying the compilation errors.

arguments.description: Run maven compile to see errors

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>

-->
<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0"
         xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
         xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 http://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
    <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>

    <groupId>ids.messaging</groupId>
    <artifactId>messaging-services</artifactId>
    <version>${revision}</version>
    <packaging>pom</packaging>

    <modules>
        <module>core</module>
        <module>messaging</module>
        <module>clearinghouse</module>
        <module>broker</module>
        <module>vocol</module>
        <module>paris</module>
        <module>appstore</module>
    </modules>

    <properties>
        <revision>7.0.1</revision>

        <java.version>11</java.version>
        <maven.compiler.source>${java.version}</maven.compiler.source>
        <maven.compiler.target>${java.version}</maven.compiler.target>

        <encoding>UTF-8</encoding>
        <project.build.sourceEncoding>${encoding}</project.build.sourceEncoding>
        <project.reporting.outputEncoding>${encoding}</project.reporting.outputEncoding>
    </properties>

    <licenses>
        <license>
            <name>Apache License, Version 2.0</name>
            <url>https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0.txt</url>
            <distribution>repo</distribution>
        </license>
    </licenses>

    <repositories>
        <!-- Infomodel artifacts repository (java, serializer, interaction) -->
        <repository>
            <id>eis-ids-public</id>
            <name>Releases of IDS Infomodel (IAIS)</name>
            <url>https://maven.iais.fraunhofer.de/artifactory/eis-ids-public</url>
        </repository>
        <!-- exclude old IAIS http-repo from dependencies, not reachable any more -->
        <repository>
            <releases>
                <enabled>false</enabled>
            </releases>
            <snapshots>
                <enabled>false</enabled>
            </snapshots>
            <id>eis-public-repo</id>
            <url>http://maven.iais.fraunhofer.de/artifactory/eis-ids-public</url>
        </repository>
        <repository>
            <id>sovity-public</id>
            <url>https://pkgs.dev.azure.com/sovity/5bec6cbd-c80a-47ac-86ce-1deb26cee853/_packaging/artifact/maven/v1</url>
            <releases>
                <enabled>true</enabled>
            </releases>
            <snapshots>
                <enabled>true</enabled>
            </snapshots>
        </repository>
    </repositories>

    <dependencies>
        <!-- Infomodel artifact: java -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>de.fraunhofer.iais.eis.ids.infomodel</groupId>
            <artifactId>java</artifactId>
            <version>4.2.7</version>
            <exclusions>
                <exclusion>
                    <groupId>commons-io</groupId>
                    <artifactId>commons-io</artifactId>
                </exclusion>
            </exclusions>
        </dependency>

        <!-- Infomodel artifact: serializer -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>de.fraunhofer.iais.eis.ids</groupId>
            <artifactId>infomodel-serializer</artifactId>
            <version>4.2.8</version>
            <exclusions>
                <exclusion>
                    <groupId>commons-io</groupId>
                    <artifactId>commons-io</artifactId>
                </exclusion>
            </exclusions>
        </dependency>

        <!-- Infomodel artifact: interaction -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>de.fraunhofer.iais.eis.ids</groupId>
            <artifactId>interaction</artifactId>
            <version>4.2.7</version>
            <exclusions>
                <exclusion>
                    <groupId>org.apache.commons</groupId>
                    <artifactId>commons-compress</artifactId>
                </exclusion>
                <exclusion>
                    <groupId>commons-io</groupId>
                    <artifactId>commons-io</artifactId>
                </exclusion>
                <exclusion>
                    <groupId>org.apache.jena</groupId>
                    <artifactId>jena-core</artifactId>
                </exclusion>
            </exclusions>
        </dependency>

        <!-- https://mvnrepository.com/artifact/org.apache.jena/jena-core -->
        <!-- License: Apache License, Version 2.0 -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.apache.jena</groupId>
            <artifactId>jena-core</artifactId>
            <version>4.6.1</version>
        </dependency>

        <!-- https://mvnrepository.com/artifact/org.springframework.boot/spring-boot-starter -->
        <!-- License: Apache License, Version 2.0 -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter</artifactId>
            <version>3.0.2</version>
        </dependency>

        <!-- https://mvnrepository.com/artifact/com.squareup.okhttp3/okhttp -->
        <!-- License: Apache License, Version 2.0 -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.squareup.okhttp3</groupId>
            <artifactId>okhttp</artifactId>
            <version>4.10.0</version>
        </dependency>

        <!-- https://mvnrepository.com/artifact/commons-fileupload/commons-fileupload -->
        <!-- License: Apache License, Version 2.0 -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>commons-fileupload</groupId>
            <artifactId>commons-fileupload</artifactId>
            <version>1.4</version>
            <exclusions>
                <exclusion>
                    <groupId>commons-io</groupId>
                    <artifactId>commons-io</artifactId>
                </exclusion>
            </exclusions>
        </dependency>

        <!-- https://mvnrepository.com/artifact/commons-io/commons-io -->
        <!-- License: Apache License, Version 2.0 -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>commons-io</groupId>
            <artifactId>commons-io</artifactId>
            <version>2.11.0</version>
        </dependency>

        <!-- https://mvnrepository.com/artifact/org.projectlombok/lombok -->
        <!-- License: The MIT License -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.projectlombok</groupId>
            <artifactId>lombok</artifactId>
            <version>1.18.24</version>
            <scope>provided</scope>
        </dependency>

        <!-- https://mvnrepository.com/artifact/javax.servlet/javax.servlet-api -->
        <!-- License: CDDL + GPLv2 with classpath exception https://oss.oracle.com/licenses/CDDL+GPL-1.1 -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>javax.servlet</groupId>
            <artifactId>javax.servlet-api</artifactId>
            <version>4.0.1</version>
            <scope>provided</scope>
        </dependency>

        <!-- https://mvnrepository.com/artifact/org.springframework.boot/spring-boot-starter-test -->
        <!-- License: Apache License, Version 2.0 -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-test</artifactId>
            <version>2.7.5</version>
            <scope>test</scope>
            <exclusions>
                <exclusion>
                    <groupId>org.junit.vintage</groupId>
                    <artifactId>junit-vintage-engine</artifactId>
                </exclusion>
                <exclusion>
                    <groupId>com.vaadin.external.google</groupId>
                    <artifactId>android-json</artifactId>
                </exclusion>
            </exclusions>
        </dependency>

        <!-- https://mvnrepository.com/artifact/org.junit.jupiter/junit-jupiter-api -->
        <!-- License: Eclipse Public License v2.0 -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.junit.jupiter</groupId>
            <artifactId>junit-jupiter-api</artifactId>
            <version>5.9.1</version>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>

        <!-- https://mvnrepository.com/artifact/org.junit.jupiter/junit-jupiter-engine -->
        <!-- License: Eclipse Public License v2.0 -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.junit.jupiter</groupId>
            <artifactId>junit-jupiter-engine</artifactId>
            <version>5.9.1</version>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>

        <!-- https://mvnrepository.com/artifact/org.junit.jupiter/junit-jupiter -->
        <!-- License: Eclipse Public License v2.0 -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.junit.jupiter</groupId>
            <artifactId>junit-jupiter</artifactId>
            <version>5.9.1</version>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>


        <!-- https://mvnrepository.com/artifact/com.squareup.okhttp3/mockwebserver -->
        <!-- License: Apache License, Version 2.0 -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.squareup.okhttp3</groupId>
            <artifactId>mockwebserver</artifactId>
            <version>4.10.0</version>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>

        <!-- https://mvnrepository.com/artifact/org.springframework/spring-test -->
        <!-- License: Apache License, Version 2.0 -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-test</artifactId>
            <version>5.3.24</version>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>

        <!-- https://mvnrepository.com/artifact/org.springframework/spring-core -->
        <!-- License: Apache License, Version 2.0 -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-core</artifactId>
            <version>5.3.24</version>
        </dependency>

        <!-- https://mvnrepository.com/artifact/org.apache.commons/commons-compress -->
        <!-- License: Apache License, Version 2.0 -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.apache.commons</groupId>
            <artifactId>commons-compress</artifactId>
            <version>1.22</version>
        </dependency>
    </dependencies>

    <build>
        <plugins>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.codehaus.mojo</groupId>
                <artifactId>flatten-maven-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>1.3.0</version>
                <configuration>
                    <updatePomFile>true</updatePomFile>
                    <flattenMode>resolveCiFriendliesOnly</flattenMode>
                </configuration>
                <executions>
                    <execution>
                        <id>flatten</id>
                        <phase>process-resources</phase>
                        <goals>
                            <goal>flatten</goal>
                        </goals>
                    </execution>
                    <execution>
                        <id>flatten.clean</id>
                        <phase>clean</phase>
                        <goals>
                            <goal>clean</goal>
                        </goals>
                    </execution>
                </executions>
            </plugin>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-source-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>3.2.1</version>
                <executions>
                    <execution>
                        <id>attach-sources</id>
                        <goals>
                            <goal>jar</goal>
                        </goals>
                    </execution>
                </executions>
            </plugin>
            <plugin>
                <artifactId>maven-compiler-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>3.10.1</version>
            </plugin>
            <plugin>
                <artifactId>maven-dependency-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>3.4.0</version>
            </plugin>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-checkstyle-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>3.2.0</version>
                <dependencies>
                    <dependency>
                        <groupId>com.puppycrawl.tools</groupId>
                        <artifactId>checkstyle</artifactId>
                        <version>10.5.0</version>
                    </dependency>
                </dependencies>
                <configuration>
                    <configLocation>scripts/ci/checkstyle.xml</configLocation>
                    <encoding>UTF-8</encoding>
                    <consoleOutput>true</consoleOutput>
                    <failOnViolation>true</failOnViolation>
                </configuration>
            </plugin>
        </plugins>
    </build>

    <profiles>
        <profile>
            <id>no-tests</id>
            <properties>
                <maven.test.skip>true</maven.test.skip>
            </properties>
        </profile>
        <profile>
            <id>release</id>
            <properties>
                <!-- Force override profile "no-tests" -->
                <maven.test.skip>false</maven.test.skip>
            </properties>
            <distributionManagement>
                <repository>
                    <id>sovity-public</id>
                    <url>https://pkgs.dev.azure.com/sovity/5bec6cbd-c80a-47ac-86ce-1deb26cee853/_packaging/artifact/maven/v1</url>
                    <releases>
                        <enabled>true</enabled>
                    </releases>
                    <snapshots>
                        <enabled>true</enabled>
                    </snapshots>
                </repository>
            </distributionManagement>
            <build>
                <plugins>
                    <plugin>
                        <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                        <artifactId>maven-javadoc-plugin</artifactId>
                        <version>3.4.1</version>
                        <executions>
                            <execution>
                                <id>attach-javadocs</id>
                                <goals>
                                    <goal>jar</goal>
                                </goals>
                            </execution>
                        </executions>
                        <configuration>
                            <source>11</source>
                        </configuration>
                    </plugin>
                    <plugin>
                        <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                        <artifactId>maven-source-plugin</artifactId>
                        <version>3.2.1</version>
                        <executions>
                            <execution>
                                <id>attach-sources</id>
                                <goals>
                                    <goal>jar</goal>
                                </goals>
                            </execution>
                        </executions>
                    </plugin>
                    <plugin>
                        <artifactId>maven-deploy-plugin</artifactId>
                        <version>3.0.0</version>
                        <executions>
                            <execution>
                                <id>default-deploy</id>
                                <phase>deploy</phase>
                                <goals>
                                    <goal>deploy</goal>
                                </goals>
                            </execution>
                        </executions>
                    </plugin>
                    <plugin>
                        <groupId>org.codehaus.mojo</groupId>
                        <artifactId>flatten-maven-plugin</artifactId>
                        <version>1.3.0</version>
                        <configuration>
                            <updatePomFile>true</updatePomFile>
                            <flattenMode>resolveCiFriendliesOnly</flattenMode>
                        </configuration>
                        <executions>
                            <execution>
                                <id>flatten</id>
                                <phase>process-resources</phase>
                                <goals>
                                    <goal>flatten</goal>
                                </goals>
                            </execution>
                            <execution>
                                <id>flatten.clean</id>
                                <phase>clean</phase>
                                <goals>
                                    <goal>clean</goal>
                                </goals>
                            </execution>
                        </executions>
                    </plugin>
                </plugins>
            </build>
        </profile>
    </profiles>
</project>

steps.message:
Now I understand the issue. The error `class file has wrong version 61.0, should be 55.0` indicates a Java version mismatch:
- Java 17 = class version 61.0
- Java 11 = class version 55.0

Spring Boot 3.x requires Java 17+, but the project is configured for Java 11. The fix requires:
1. Update Java version to 17
2. Update `javax.servlet` to `jakarta.servlet` (Spring Boot 3 uses Jakarta EE)
3. Ensure consistent Spring dependency versions

The build is now successful. All 8 modules compiled successfully. Let me provide a summary of the changes made:

## Summary

The Maven compilation failure after upgrading `spring-boot-starter` from 2.7.5 to 3.0.2 has been fixed. The following changes were made to `/IDS-Messaging-Services/pom.xml`:

### Key Changes:

1. **Updated Java version** from 11 to 17 (Spring Boot 3.x requires Java 17+)

2. **Updated Spring dependencies** to be consistent with Spring Boot 3.0.2:
   - `spring-boot-starter-test`: 2.7.5 → 3.0.2
   - `spring-test`: 5.3.24 → 6.0.4
   - `spring-core`: 5.3.24 → 6.0.4

3. **Updated Jakarta/Java EE dependencies**:
   - Replaced `javax.servlet-api` with `jakarta.servlet-api` (6.0.0)
   - Replaced `javax.validation-api` with `jakarta.validation-api` (3.0.2)
   - Added back `javax.servlet-api` (4.0.1) as it's still required by `commons-fileupload`

4. **Updated Lombok** from 1.18.24 to 1.18.30 for better Java 17 support

5. **Updated commons-fileupload** from 1.4 to 1.5

### Source Code Changes:

Replaced `javax.*` imports with `jakarta.*` in the following files:
- `messaging/src/main/java/ids/messaging/endpoint/EndpointService.java`
- `messaging/src/main/java/ids/messaging/endpoint/MessageController.java`
- `messaging/src/test/java/ids/messaging/endpoint/MessageControllerTest.java`
- `core/src/main/java/ids/messaging/core/config/ConfigProperties.java`

**Note**: Java 17 was installed on the system to support Spring Boot 3.x.
